news.title: Customer Momentum and G2 Recognition Strengthen Adaptive Security’s Market Position

bullets: Own the roadmap for your product area. Prioritize ruthlessly based on customer impact, business value, and technical feasibility. Then defend your bets to leadership and GTM.
Be the voice of the customer. Run discovery calls, mine support tickets, and synthesize what you hear into clear problem statements.
Ship. Build prototypes, partner with eng and design to make tradeoffs, and drive execution through launch. You're accountable for outcomes, not just output.
Work cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and CS to shape positioning, enable the GTM team, and close the loop on customer feedback.
Instrument and monitor product metrics. Use data to validate hypotheses, catch problems early, and inform what to build next.
